latin: Species sunt in medio, medio modo inter esse spirituale et materiale.
translation: Species exist in the medium in a mode midway between spiritual and material being.
translation_note: 'species' here are the sensible intentional forms (e.g. of light or color) transmitted through a medium, not biological species (farmer1998:13889).
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch2, from Latin at farmer1998:13889
not_established: No secondary scholarship discussing thesis 9.9 specifically was found in the corpus harvest; the attribution to al-Farabi rests on the 900 Conclusions' own section rubric, not on external confirmation.
